caption: The video captures a largely static outdoor view of a parking lot beside a single-story building with a brown roof on the right. In the left foreground, a large white parabolic satellite dish stands on a blue support frame above a grassy slope. A row of parked cars, including dark and light-colored sedans, hatchbacks, and SUVs, lines the asphalt lot, with a small sign and a tall light pole in the middle ground. Bare-branched trees frame the right edge and the horizon. The sky is dominated by a thick layer of grey-and-white clouds, which gradually shift and reorganize across the scene. The bright central cloud mass changes shape and edges as more patches of blue sky open up, most noticeably in the upper-right quadrant. The lower-left cloud bank also thins and drifts slightly, while the dish, building, pole, sign, and every parked car keep the same positions and orientations throughout the visible portion.
relations: Cloud layer drifts and reorganizes across the sky, with the bright central mass changing shape and edges.
As clouds thin, patches of blue sky open up, most noticeably in the upper-right quadrant.
The lower-left cloud bank thins and drifts slightly over time.
The dish, building, pole, sign, and every parked car keep fixed positions and orientations.
